system.summary: Tokyo (Huang Xing) → “Junzaburo”, without indicator, and Shanghai → “Ylchang” (Huang Xing), late May – June 1916. Table recovered in October 2026. Not to be confused with the three-kana code of another telegram of Huang Xing (25 May 1916, to Lin Hu and Li Genyuan), whose system was identified by D. Bourdeau and whose formula by S. Tomokiyo[22, 23].

prior_solution.where: Not in this repository (pointer only in sunyatsen/y1916); no decipherment on the JACAR copies; Cryptiana checked.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the rules and re-read doubtful letters on the scans in blind panels; AI agents transcribed, searched the condenser family, decoded and translated.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Telegrams transcribed from the JACAR PDFs; doubtful letters re-read by Brice Dudout in blind panels.
Search of the condenser family (consonant rotation, vowel order) scored with a Chinese character model; key accepted only if it read telegrams it was not fitted to.
Chinese text punctuated and translated; doubtful codes marked.

validation.notes: Chinese plaintext through the telegraph code: the letter n-gram test cannot run on Chinese characters; the readings were checked by sense

outcome.fraction_read_source: 264 of 266 codes give a character (doubtful codes counted as read; see decryption.txt).

credits.note: Huang Xing's table: key and 9 telegram(s) read, with transcriptions, decryptions, Chinese texts and English translations

gaps.detail: copying and transmission errors on the Japanese copies
